note: **2 Lenton Road, schedule 265 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Agnes Lymbery, 89 and widowed, in the house the 1921 census found her in with her husband Richard Henry, with a housekeeper and a domestic servant.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
